names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9609, «Иоанн (Заседателев), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words left off; the day line gives «Иоанна пресвитера» without the surname, and the surname is the index's.

death.note: The Russian day line, and the only thing printed about him besides his name and his rank: «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1942)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1942).»
source.note: No rank is recorded: the line carries no service icon. The day has exactly one, standing before Longinus the Centurion at the head of the paragraph.

attestations.note: **The calendar prints a line and nothing else.** The day line gives the rank, the name and the year; his name page 9609 adds the surname, «Иоанн (Заседателев), иерей, сщмч.», and the second day he is kept on, «26 января (Новомуч.)» — and then stops. There is no life link on either page. The January day was not read. azbyka.ru answered **403** to the corpus's own fetcher on 28 October 2026 and was not asked again. He is the last of the day's four twentieth-century priests and the only one of the four to die in the war years; the Russian 15 October, the day before, has its own priest of 1942, Demetrius (Kasatkin), and the two are different men with different index numbers and different surnames.
